{{Top}}
'''Gulliball''' was a very popular sport played on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Equipped with mallets made from [[zaela tree]] branches, Gungans batted around [[gullipud]]s in attempts to place them in specified goal areas. For some reason, the animals actually enjoyed being tossed around.<ref name="FOW">''[[Episode I Adventures 10: Festival of Warriors]]''</ref>
